mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over a 2-month window coincides with a decline in 20-day S&P 500 forward returns, reflecting market anticipation of tighter policy and reduced equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in two consecutive months
regime_hint: rising inflation in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: Over a 3-year window, the 20-day forward return remains non-negative whenever CPIAUCSL exceeds 0.3% for two consecutive months, or the inflation spike is followed by a delayed but persistent rally in SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% for three consecutive months signals wage pressures that prompt a 60-day S&P 500 forward return decline as investors anticipate higher inflation and rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >0.5% for three consecutive months
regime_hint: rising labor costs in a tight labor market
failure_condition: During regimes where labor costs are rising, the 60-day forward return is non-negative more than 70% of the time despite the three-month wage acceleration signal.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS industrial production index of at least 2% predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as market interprets weakening supply-side constraints and potential easing in demand pressures.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > -2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In supply-side softening regimes, the 20-day forward return does not outperform the prior month's average when RSAFS declines > -2% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly rise in INDPRO (≥1.5%) combined with a simultaneous decline in HOUST (≥5%) for one month indicates a shift toward demand-driven supply constraints, which is associated with a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as producers pass costs to consumers.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases ≥1.5% while HOUST decreases ≥5% in the same month
failure_condition: Over 12 months in demand-supply imbalanced regimes, the 5-day forward return is not statistically different from zero when the interaction pattern occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% for four consecutive months, absent a concurrent inflation spike in CPIAUCSL, predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate prolonged easing and rate stability.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls <1% for four consecutive months and CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.2% over the same period
failure_condition: During prolonged low-rate periods, the 60-day forward return is negative whenever FEDFUNDS <1% for four months and CPIAUCSL ≤0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden, one-time drop in UNRATE below 5% in a month coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate a softening labor market and potential rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% in a single month
failure_condition: In labor market softening regimes, the 20-day forward return is not significantly negative when UNRATE drops below 5% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A two-month consecutive decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% suggests a near-term demand shock, which is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate profit compression.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > -2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: During identified demand contraction regimes, the 20-day forward return remains non-negative whenever GDPC1 declines > -2% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise in INDPRO (≥0.8%) and a sustained monthly decline in RSAFS (≥-1.5%) for two consecutive months indicates worsening supply bottlenecks, which predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market fears deflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases ≥0.8% while RSAFS decreases ≥ -1.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: In supply-bottleneck regimes, the 60-day forward return is not significantly negative when the interaction pattern persists for two months.
